The design pass. Establish the language's real affordances by probe, derive an architecture from them, file the blockers as defects with reproductions, and work out the proposal each rung needs. Carries no verification: it is the work that decides what verifying would even look like.

```day-bridge
{"telos":"verified-core-grows","have":["language-question"],"plan":{"seq":[{"atom":"language-probe"},{"all":[{"atom":"gap-report"},{"atom":"architecture-design"}]},{"atom":"rfc-draft"}]}}
```

bridge/climb-the-ladder does not reach telos/verified-core-grows, and day is right to say so. The telos's witness is verified-source: subsystems moving into proven Thermite. A design pass produces none. It produces the conditions under which a later bridge could — an architecture derived from the language's real affordances, and the blockers filed. Left failing deliberately: a red check telling the truth beats a green one that does not.
